name: On Second Thought
body:
You are able to partition your mind, relying on your two separate identities to provide you with added mental defenses.

Prerequisite(s): dual identity class feature, quick change social talent, vigilante level 7th.

Benefit(s): When you fail a saving throw against a mind-affecting effect, you can change your mental state to your other identity (from social to vigilante, or vice versa) for a brief moment as an ? immediate action; this does not involve any kind of physical transformation. Your other identity makes the same saving throw against the effect, and you take whichever result is most favorable. You remain in the identity you started in, and you are staggered on your next turn. If you also have the immediate change social talent, you are not staggered.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
